typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{First Name} as string,
		{Last Name} as string,
		Address1 as string,
		Address2 as string,
		City as string,
		State as string,
		Zip as string,
		{Office Phone} as string,
		{National Provider ID} as string,
		{Practice Name} as string,
		Survey_Type as string,
		{Primary Specialty} as string,
		{Provider ID} as string,
		TIN as string,
		Title as string,
		{Product Type} as string,
		{Practitioner ID} as string,
		{Medicaid ID} as string,
		{Panel Status} as string,
		{Practice Number} as string,
		Specialty2 as string,
		Specialty3 as string,
		TotalMembers as string,
		County as string,
		{Medicare ID} as string,
		{Region Type} as string,
		{Provider Fax} as string,
		Prescribers as string,
		{High Volume} as string,
		{High  Impact} as string,
		{Contract Codes} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	procedureName: 'PR_PROV_ACCESS_SURVEY_REPORT
WITH RESULT SETS (
(
[First Name] varchar(55',
	schemaName: 'EXTRACT',
	resultSet: true,
	format: 'procedure',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of TIN} = toString(TIN),
		{Copy of Survey_Type} = toString(Survey_Type),
		{Copy of Title} = toString(Title),
		{Copy of Zip} = toString(Zip),
		{Copy of Address1} = toString(Address1),
		{Copy of Specialty2} = toString(Specialty2),
		{Copy of Prescribers} = toString(Prescribers),
		{Copy of State} = toString(State),
		{Copy of TotalMembers} = toString(TotalMembers),
		{Copy of City} = toString(City),
		{Copy of County} = toString(County),
		{Copy of Specialty3} = toString(Specialty3),
		{Copy of Address2} = toString(Address2)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
